## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 329 captures during January 2020. This represents the site’s total capture activity for the reporting month. Activity was recorded through the clinic’s usual operational arrangements, with no new equipment faults raised by staff during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 329 captures, 13 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.0. These images could not be used for grading and were recorded separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The result provides a measure of image quality for the activity completed at Market Eye Clinic during January 2020.

## Grading

A total of 51 results were graded as referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This indicates the typical interval for completion of grading during the reporting month. The referable results and grading lag should be considered alongside the ungradable activity when reviewing the site’s overall performance for January 2020.
